mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreases significantly.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in retail sales signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS increases sharply.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production signals a slowdown in economic activity, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where both PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts signals increased demand for new homes, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST increases significantly.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index signals reduced inflationary pressure, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP signals strong economic growth, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 increases.
